notes.title: Again update 1.4.1
notes.notes:
Dear Again community,

This is George from Redpix Games. Wanted to let everyone know through a community post that the game has been updated to version 1.4.1 and here's what the changelog looks like:


 The most annoying issue with the controls not working on some computers is solved, controls are smooth and responsive now.
 Updated the engine version and post-processing stack so that the game looks better.
 Now we have a small town like prop randomly generated at the bottom of the game to add an ability to easily guess the orientation of the player in-game, acts as a decoration.
 Some bug fixes with the level selection in-game screen and added SFX volume slider on the options screen.
 Horizontal and vertical moving platform control issues fixed in levels 2-5.
 Other minor fixes and improvements.


There's also a brand new Discord server for Redpix Games available here and I'm accepting people who would love to give a helping hand and moderate the server.

Thanks for your attention, please enjoy the game and let me know if there are any issues that we can fix together for your best experience.

Best,
George | Redpix Games LLC

notes.title: Update on the controls fix on some platforms
notes.notes:
Dear Again community,

We are sorry that you are experiencing issues with movement and jump controls. As noted here on our website in the launch news some people are having said issues. Everything is working perfectly on the main development computer, thus making things a bit harder. We are looking for a fix that works on all platforms. You will receive an update containing the fix and a post here on our community hub about that update very soon. 

Thanks for being patient.

George | Redpix Games LLC
